summary: On 'fwgr79-n1 Bench Dashboard' I opened Dashboard settings → Time options and set Auto refresh to "1m", saved ("Dashboard saved"), then selected 1m in the top-bar refresh picker and saved again with "Update default refresh value" ticked so it persists. The required verification — the settings page after reload — confirms it: after a full page reload the settings page shows Auto refresh = "1m" (input#auto-refresh-input), and the top-bar refresh menu offers exactly Off / Auto / 1m with 1m in effect (URL carries refresh=1m). Title, tag "bench" and time range (Last 6 hours / now-6h) are unchanged. Additionally noted: the JSON Model Monaco pane in this Grafana build only renders one visible line at a time, so the settings-after-reload route (explicitly allowed by the instruction) was used for verification; a failed find-box step had typed the text "refresh" into the JSON Model editor, and that local edit was never saved — the reload discarded it and all post-reload reads show the persisted model intact. URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfzftybx71lvke/fwgr79-n1-bench-dashboard. (auto_refresh_in_settings_after_reload: Settings → Time options → Auto refresh, input#auto-refresh-input)

values.top_bar_refresh_after_reload: 1m, from menu offering exactly "Off / Auto / 1m" (URL refreshed with refresh=1m)
